liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Highway Of Sorrow** (1 other source): Samson Grisman played bass on this song [4]
- **Close By** (1 other source): Samson Grisman played bass on this song as well [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Live And Regret**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Dealing Dispair**: back after 87 archived shows (376 days); rare: 8 archived performances [6]
- **Highway Of Sorrow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Close By**: rare: 6 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2022-08-12** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 144 min [1]
- **billystrings2022-08-12.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: source not stated; 24 songs; 144 min [2]
- **billystrings2022-08-12.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 144 min [3]
- **billystrings2022-08-12._6chMTX_hermsen.mracheck_flac2448**: source not stated; 24 songs; 143 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2022-08-12**: taped by Chad "Spitzy" Spitz; transferred by Chad "Spitzy" Spitz; source: 4channel Aud Mix [1]. Also: Recorded with AKG c451b and ck1 mics plus Busman Audio BSC2 hypers, into a USBPre2 [1]
- **billystrings2022-08-12.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY250/5i>Baby NBox>Sony PCM-A10 [2]. Also: Schoeps MK41v mics through KCY250/5i and Baby NBox into Sony PCM-A10, 24-bit/48kHz, then edited in Sound Forge, CDWAV, FLAC [2]
- **billystrings2022-08-12.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY250/5i>Baby NBox>Sony PCM-A10 [3]. Also: Same Schoeps MK41v chain as the 24-bit version, but converted to 16-bit/44.1kHz in Sound Forge Pro 16 [3]
- **billystrings2022-08-12._6chMTX_hermsen.mracheck_flac2448**: taped by John Hermsen; transferred by John Hermsen; source: AKG 483 + AKG C568EB + DPA 4022 > Sound Devices Mixpre 6 [4]
